verdict.reason: The tender explicitly requires the supply and integration of an AI analytics platform to process video feeds from 75 existing CCTV cameras for safety monitoring, including the configuration of 15 AI use cases and model optimization.

evidence.quote: The scope of work shall include design, supply, installation, integration, configuration, testing, commissioning and maintenance of an AI-based Safety Monitoring System utilizing the existing CCTV camera infrastructure available at the plant.

The system shall support AI/Deep Learning-based video analytics for automatic identification of unsafe acts and unsafe conditions. The system shall be capable of monitoring 75 camera feeds simultaneously and analysing them in real time.
The bidder shall submit a detailed technical proposal containing: ... AI platform details. ... 10. List of available AI use cases. 11. Details of proposed 15-use-case implementation.

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply, installation, and integration of an AI-based safety monitoring system with hardware, software, and 2-year support for 75 CCTV cameras.
